value.rationale: Asymptotic entropy-current variance is a natural nonequilibrium thermodynamic observable not determined by mean entropy production. A complete size classification shows a unique doubling at the four-cycle due to distance-two spatial aliasing; all larger rings share an exact per-site coefficient. This is a motivated structural finite-size limitation of bulk fluctuation estimates, not an arbitrary selected parameter value.
